title: Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Bill 2013

speeches.speaker: Craig Emerson
speeches.brief: Moved the Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Bill 2013, which would allow special dividends and adjustments to callable capital, implement a 2012 budget measure, and respond to the Productivity Commission's findings on surplus capital and EFIC's future mandate.

speeches.speaker: Julie Bishop
speeches.brief: Argued that the bill would enable a $200 million special dividend from EFIC, criticised the government's budget management and spending, and said the coalition did not oppose the measure.

speeches.speaker: Warren Truss
speeches.brief: Noted that no Labor speakers had defended the Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Bill 2013 and suggested the minister might respond.

speeches.speaker: Warren Truss
speeches.brief: Argued that taking $200 million from EFIC would reduce support for Australian exporters, criticised the government's economic management and taxes, and said the bill would weaken manufacturing and small-business export opportunities.

acts.title: Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Act 2013
